text: I love Wispr Flow because it works. I recommend giving it 5 stars and trying it out because I was a slow typer and now I just need to voice it. In this review I'm voicing it and then it turns it into text. If you don't believe it you'll see. Just try it once, download it, and you'll get used to it. You'll like it. You won't stress about writing anymore. You can also write lists of stuff, like what you want to do, or you can write schedules to a friend.
